gates.title: Primary version and acquisition-supplement gaps
gates.requirement: Authenticate author-linked NLB copy against proceedings if available; recover Churchland display equations/images/supplement before any full-acquisition-paper coverage claim. No source text substitute for missing images.

checkpoints.requirement: Exact licensed primary identities and all version/supplement gaps disclosed; source-specific scope only.
Missing proceedings equality and acquisition supplement remain explicit and block full-paper-reproduction claims; no completeness waiver.

gates.title: Exact empirical assets and rights
gates.requirement: Later operator-only proof of selected DANDI version/assets, current rights and all1721/574,137/45,140 identities; no newly opened body in this phase.

checkpoints.requirement: All selected raw/split/rights/1721/574/137/45/140 identities qualified by operator-only preparation.

gates.title: Raw mapping and native conversion
gates.requirement: Official timing/ceil/half-open bins, observed intervals, heldout flags and all-cell count conservation under pinned real dependency versions; no overlapping raw support or missing cells.

checkpoints.requirement: Complete native timing/masks/count conservation and no overlapping/missing support; no performance statistic.

gates.title: Dependency source closure
gates.requirement: Exact numerical dependency versions/implementations including GPFA Elephant/Neo/quantities/sklearn; source adapters and all import dependencies authenticated, licensed and independently reviewed.

checkpoints.requirement: Actual complete source/dependency identities and versions, including all numerical libraries; no runtime import proxy.

gates.title: Complete reference producers
gates.requirement: R0–R8 actual training/search/state/inference producers; all native folds/grid rows/45GLMs/retries and final refits connected; no stored-score or named-callback proxy.

checkpoints.requirement: All scheduled training-stage native searches/folds/units/retries/refits complete. R5 full-training GPFA is here; its final query-dependent Ridge/Poisson sequence is S06, so no query-dependent product is demanded before legal observed-query exposure.
Every condition-applicable reference prediction and transductive state has actual producer ancestry; no unavailable-member substitution.

gates.title: Native mathematical parity
gates.requirement: Independent numerical/native positive-domain metric parity, smoothing edge rules, GPFA binning/factors/transduction, source selection/ties and all baseline algorithms. Scientific tests remain unexecuted.

checkpoints.requirement: Native/math parity uses only authorized invented/training support, including source GPFA and metric domain; not held-out assessment evidence.

gates.title: Reference competence
gates.requirement: Two distinct checkpoints: source-faithful training/inner-development competence, convergence and difficulty reporting before agent study; full 574-case assessment competence/diagnostics/uncertainty only after the complete global barrier. Published or old exposed scores do not qualify either current producer checkpoint.

checkpoints.requirement: All required references pass source/convergence/domain development checks; whole difficulty table retained. Does not assert full-panel quality or require positive neural gain.

Evaluate all required references on every one of the 574 cases with full diagnostics/uncertainty before scientific claims. No outcome changes methods, rosters or policy; negative competent results remain reportable.

gates.title: Current process isolation
gates.requirement: Real worker namespaces/no network and no targets/shared histories, captured arbitrary source execution, descendant absence and protected process isolation on chosen host.

checkpoints.requirement: Real chosen-host containment and permitted roles with no empirical target access by workers.
All original actors/descendants absent and no uncontained source or history access; unknown prevents barrier.

gates.title: Original resource envelope
gates.requirement: Fresh cost/history/current-capacity grants and actual physical quotas, all original min-deadlines, final CPU meters and output/reserved terminal accounting; no cap reset.

checkpoints.requirement: Current cost/history and physical quota grants, fixed original clocks, finite nested budgets and reserved terminal capacity.
Original final CPU/wall/bytes/unknowns and all actual consumed costs admitted; no over-limit success or reset.

gates.title: First-cause terminal custody
gates.requirement: All process/stream/measurement/close/encoding/publication failures preserve original causes, final observations and truthful persistence, with exact caller consumption; no replay.

checkpoints.requirement: Actual inert first-cause/cleanup/stream/encoding/publication controls.
Every real invocation retains its original first cause and complete final/persistence truth; no replay to replace missing observations.

gates.title: Global collection barrier
gates.requirement: After privileged operator-only raw preparation seals target roles, all primary/declared diagnostic arms, seeds, cases and reference producers frozen and absent before assessment target open; complete case IDs and immutable copied artifacts. Preparation never grants participant or fit/selection access.

checkpoints.requirement: Entire fixed roster, all 574 outputs per required producer, complete immutable custody and absence before assessment target access.

gates.title: Observed-query transduction
gates.requirement: Same whole query pool for F/I; exact permitted observed-only calibration ancestry including GPFA held-in readout then training-label GLM; no withheld query label derivative.

checkpoints.requirement: Identical whole observed-query access for F/I, explicit training-label permission and forbidden withheld-query supervision.
Actual full GPFA and other adaptation ancestry; shuffled pools rebuild every query-dependent state without intact-state cache.

gates.title: Cross-case/development isolation
gates.requirement: Fresh case and arm contexts; no answer/feedback reuse; exact pre-exposure source/policy freeze; historical public-label and other-task exposures disclosed.

checkpoints.requirement: Whole-trial training splits, fresh independent arm/case contexts and pre-exposure method/source/policy commitments.
All actual state/case dependencies and absence of evaluation feedback or cross-case answer reuse.

gates.title: Actual model/tool protocol
gates.requirement: Authenticated chosen model source/runtime or API identity, genuine model exchanges and submitted Python processes, numeric predicted arrays, all token/error accounting. No provider selected now.

checkpoints.requirement: Chosen actual service/runtime identity and bounded source-independent engineering protocol; no unselected provider.
Genuine model/tool/observation/numeric-output ancestry and all token/error counters, not scripted source labels.

gates.title: Matched feasibility
gates.requirement: Preselected matched total budgets and finite per-case partition feasible on training-only evidence; identical tool/reference access, realized use and amortized expert construction costs disclosed.

checkpoints.requirement: Only training-derived feasibility evidence, same total fixed envelopes and finite case partitions; unknown actual future capacity stays a gate.
Realized participant, preparation, reference and amortized costs retained; no per-case multiplication or changed pairing.

gates.title: Complete protected bank scoring
gates.requirement: Independent source-owned scorer, exact old R1 metric retained, all signed full-bank/paired deltas and private normalization, valid-unscorable versus invalid/operator errors distinguished.

checkpoints.requirement: Independent scorer/domain/math qualified without assessment targets; arbitrary strictly-positive predictions remain eligible.
All 574-cell supports and fixed signed comparisons, private normalizer, distinct invalid/unscorable statuses.

gates.title: Paired uncertainty qualification
gates.requirement: 574trial6300cell adapter to existing core, same resamples/draw denominator, full10000draws/zero-denominator failure; chronology-sensitive block wrapper separately qualified.

checkpoints.requirement: 574x6300 wrapper, draw policy and chronology algorithm qualified on permitted training/invented evidence.
All 10000 fixed draws and paired denominators, exact chronology sensitivity or explicit unavailable status; missing uncertainty blocks the planned complete inference claim.

gates.title: Agent-repeat and multiplicity plan
gates.requirement: All five paired seeds, full preregistered families and honest conditional resampling assumptions; missing seed/condition prevents planned complete-study claim.

checkpoints.requirement: All five seeds, 100 groups, 65 contrasts and five families committed, no favorite-seed/reference choice.
All fixed components and uncertainty accounted; missing component remains unavailable, not a changed family.

gates.title: Diagnostic validity
gates.requirement: Physical context-only/rate-only omission; fixed within-condition shuffle support; tool-only and narrative changes with unchanged units/axes; no causal or native-understanding overclaim.

checkpoints.requirement: Physical projections and protected shuffle rule/commitment fixed without assessment activity/outcomes.
Full same-support intact/shuffle/context/rate/tool/metadata diagnostic outcomes, all limitations, no causal/native-understanding overclaim.

gates.title: Reasoning and report validity
gates.requirement: Blinded separate factual/scientific rubric, complete negative findings, reliability/disagreement; no preferred-answer wording gate or metric alteration.

checkpoints.requirement: Separate blinded rubric and disagreement rules committed before performance outcomes.
Actual report judging consumes only committed aggregate feedback after full barrier, cannot refit or alter numeric scores.

gates.title: Exposure and external validity
gates.requirement: Long-public validation/original-test releases, historical adaptation, source-context inequality and shared Churchland/sliceTCA data documented; independent corpus needed for external confirmation.

checkpoints.requirement: Historical/public targets and related-corpus exposure disclosed; no promise of contamination-free data.
One exposed session, exact validation/test and acquisition-date differences; external confirmation remains missing.

gates.title: Publication and RL boundaries
gates.requirement: No local-only primary/raw transport/targets/model states/private histories in public release; participant paper access separately licensed; evaluation feedback never recycled as training reward.

checkpoints.requirement: Licensed matched paper access and source-only publication/RL restrictions; no targets/model/private histories in participant/public views.
Final release excludes local-only bodies and private derivatives; assessment feedback never becomes evaluated training reward.

gates.title: Independent whole design review
gates.requirement: Different reviewer accepts complete scientific/API design before implementation; source acceptance does not close empirical gates.

checkpoints.requirement: Different independent complete design acceptance before implementation; this successor remains unaccepted.

gates.title: Complete implementation and execution selection
gates.requirement: Implement actual missing adapters/controllers and whole engineering review, then separate authorized authentic qualification; no readiness/count promotion from this design.

checkpoints.requirement: Full implementation/whole source review and separate authentic authority, not requiring a future assessment result to authorize qualification.
Actual full programme and all required coverage/evidence before complete qualification claim; C46 is future end-to-end evidence, not a pre-study prerequisite.

checkpoint_semantics: 24 gates retained, each with explicit stage-specific evidence. A satisfied pre-study checkpoint never closes a gate that still requires post-barrier evidence. All checkpoints are open and unproduced in this design. Prerequisite evaluation uses the stated checkpoint, never all future gate components.
